summary: Iteration 4 frontend-only verification of the 5 requested changes on top of the previously-passing DialyGo Phase-I build. All 13 test areas pass. (1) Operator file upload: [data-testid=operator-file-input] accepts any file, [data-testid=uploaded-file-name] shows the filename and green [data-testid=uploaded-label]='Uploaded' badge, [data-testid=patient-details-modal] auto-opens with title 'Enter Patient Details'. (2) Modal has all 9 fields with correct test ids and types (form-name, form-age number, form-gender select Male/Female/Other, form-uhid, form-diagnosis, form-access-type select AV Fistula/AV Graft/Catheter, form-access-flow number, form-next-session, form-schedule) using the existing Dialog+Input styling. (3) [data-testid=patient-details-submit-btn] closes the modal immediately and appends exactly ONE new patient card (id DUR-PT-<uhid last 5>) populated with all entered values (verified name/age/gender/UHID/diagnosis/access-type/access-flow/next-session/schedule). (4) Ramesh Iyer (DUR-PT-00218), Fatima Sheikh (DUR-PT-00341) and Joseph D'Souza (DUR-PT-00477) cards remain unchanged after add. (5) Operator counters stay pinned: Scheduled today=3, Patients with high attention=3 both before and after. Doctor home 'Patients under review'=3 unchanged. (6) Cross-role visibility: after in-app profile-menu switch-role-doctor + sidebar click, the new patient card appears on /doctor/patients AND /doctor/home alongside the 3 originals (verified 4 cards, custom card visible). (7) Run Report 3-state on the NEW card only: [data-testid=run-report-btn-<id>] shows 'Run Report' idle -> disabled 'Analyzing...' with spinner -> replaced after ~2.5s by [data-testid=generated-report-<id>] containing Summary, Risk flag (Access dysfunction risk - moderate) and Recommendation lines. No run-report button on Ramesh/Fatima/Joseph cards. (8) Doctor name 'Dr. Girish Reddy' appears in doctor profile-name topbar, clinical history notes, prescription verifiedBy, generated report card ('Reviewed by Dr. Girish Reddy'), admin doctors table, and Clinical Review defaults; no occurrence of 'Dr. N. Bhatt' anywhere under /app/frontend/src (grep-verified). (9) Functional breadcrumb — Doctor: /doctor/patients='Home/Patients', /doctor/patient-360='Home/Patients/Ramesh Iyer', /doctor/clinical-history='Home/Patients/Ramesh Iyer/Clinical History'. breadcrumb-link-1 -> /doctor/patients, breadcrumb-link-2 -> /doctor/patient-360; last segment is plain text (no link). (10) Operator breadcrumb: /operator/search='Home/Patients', /operator/pre-session='Home/Patients/Ramesh Iyer', /operator/vascular='Home/Patients/Ramesh Iyer/Vascular Access', /operator/history='Home/Patients/Ramesh Iyer/Patient History'. (11) Non-patient pages retain static 2-part crumbs: /operator/home='Operator/Home', /roadmap='Platform/Future Roadmap'. (12) Regression: existing worklist cards, workflow strip, profile menu role switcher (all 5 roles), login flow all still functional and unchanged. (13) Visual: reuses existing Panel/Input/Dialog primitives and navy/saffron theme; no new styles introduced.
critical_code_review_comments: AppLayout.js line 287: the 'Active patient' chip uses patients.find (mock array) instead of allPatients (mock+custom). If a custom patient is selected, the header chip will show blank. Minor cosmetic; the rest of the app already handles custom via usePatientContext.

AppContext.buildCustomPatient clones patients[1] (Fatima) as the template and only overrides the 9 entered fields — this is intentional per the task note so charts/tabs keep working, but means the new card's 'Access risk' badge and 'high-priority attention point(s)' banner still reflect Fatima's derived engine output (e.g., 'Repeated intradialytic hypotension') rather than the entered data. Acceptable for a mock but worth documenting.

OperatorHome.newPatientIds is component-local state, so if the operator navigates away from /operator/home and returns via in-app nav, the newPatientIds set is preserved only while the OperatorHome component instance remains mounted. Once React unmounts OperatorHome the Run Report button/report card is lost even though the customPatient still exists in AppContext. Consider lifting newPatientIds/reportState into AppContext for consistency with the rest of in-memory state.

seed_data_creation: Playwright uploaded a throwaway /tmp/dummy.txt to trigger the modal; created two ephemeral custom patients (DUR-PT-99999 'Test Patient X' and DUR-PT-12345 'Cross Role P') in in-memory React state only — cleared on reload.
context_for_next_testing_agent: CRITICAL: customPatients / newPatientIds / reportState / run-report state are in-memory React state — playwright's page.goto() to an SPA URL causes a full page reload and clears them. To validate cross-role visibility use in-app navigation (sidebar links [data-testid=nav-doctor-patients], [data-testid=nav-doctor-home]) and profile menu role switch ([data-testid=profile-menu-btn] then [data-testid=switch-role-doctor]) instead of page.goto. Custom patient ids are formed as DUR-PT-<last 5 chars of UHID> — pick a distinctive UHID. Login uses [data-testid=role-option-<role>] (not role-<role>) and [data-testid=dpdp-consent-checkbox] (not login-consent-checkbox). Iteration-4 is a clean pass on all 5 requested changes with no regressions.
